source_locator: Oklahoma State Election Board results application, Local Results, FOR MAYOR CITY OF TULSA
verification_note: Oklahoma State Election Board official results for November 12, 2013 list FOR MAYOR CITY OF TULSA: Dewey Follett Bartlett, Jr. 39,739 (54.98 percent), Kathy Taylor 32,534 (45.02 percent); 195 of 195 precincts. The June 11, 2013 primary (Taylor 24,529, 42.07 percent; Bartlett 19,949; William Lee Christiansen 13,488) gave no candidate a majority, so the November general was decisive. Read in a browser on 2026-10-02.

source_locator: Oklahoma State Election Board results application, Local Results, FOR MAYOR CITY OF TULSA, Summary Results table (195/163 precincts reporting 100 percent)
verification_note: Official results for the June 28, 2016 City of Tulsa nonpartisan primary list five candidates: G T Bynum 33,064 (56.19 percent), Dewey F. Bartlett, Jr. 22,592 (38.39 percent), Tom E. McCay 1,129, Lawrence F Kirkpatrick 1,076, Paul Tay 987; total 58,848 (rows sum to total); 195 of 195 precincts. Bynum received more than 50 percent, so he was elected in the primary under the then-current Charter rule shown in the superseded text of Article VI Section 2.2. No mayoral contest appears on the November 8, 2016 Local Results list (only El Reno and Wynnewood mayors). Read in a browser on 2026-10-10.
total_votes_basis: sum of all candidates citywide, as printed in the Total row of the official table

verification_note: Official results for the August 25, 2020 City of Tulsa general election list eight candidates: GT Bynum 36,727 (51.86 percent), Gregory C. Robinson, II 20,414 (28.83 percent), Ken Reddick 9,771, Ty Walker 1,951, Craig Immel 1,313, Paul Tay 286, Ricco Wright 193, Zackri Leon Whitlow 165; total 70,820 (rows sum to total); 195 of 195 precincts. Charter Article VI Section 2.2 (as amended 2018) holds the August general election and deems elected a candidate with more than 50 percent of votes, so no November runoff was needed. The June 30, 2020 Local Results list shows no Tulsa mayor race. Read in a browser on 2026-10-10.

verification_note: Official results for the November 5, 2024 City of Tulsa mayoral run-off list Monroe Nichols 76,467 (55.63 percent) and Karen Keith 60,986 (44.37 percent); total 137,453; 163 of 163 precincts. The August 27, 2024 first round had no majority (Nichols 18,752, Brent L. VanNorman 18,021, Karen Keith 18,458, four others; total 56,614), so Charter Article VI Section 2.2 required a November run-off. The run-off is the decisive round. Read in a browser on 2026-10-10.
